description:
After their mother’s tragic passing, sisters Yeonmi and Hwiyeon want nothing more than a happy life away from their awful step-father. But it turns out that living alone and earning money is harder than it looks! Thank goodness for their mother’s adoptive brother, who swoops in to save them from certain-failure. He sets them up with both a place to live and a food truck license, and finally their dreams of happiness and independence seem to be in their grasp. But it turns out that their uncle might not be the sweet and unassuming savior that he seemed, and he’s certainly not the only one with dirty laundry… Just what will these two get up to in their quest for happiness?

(Source: Lezhin X)
